'''2010 US East Nationals''' was a Players Committee constructed event, 17 July 2010, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Legacy Open]]). The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDF ([[:File:2010 US East Nationals.pdf]]).

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Site:''' —
* '''Dates:''' 17 July 2010
* '''Winner:''' —
